item.description:
### A clearer view behind popups
The window behind a popup is softly blurred now, so the card in front is what you read. Every popup's close button is the same glass button, sitting where you expect it.
### Analytics
Day, Week and Month switch with a new sliding control — click a period or drag across to it.
### Smaller fixes
- Emergency code errors now show when a code is wrong, and Return submits it. - Parental's refresh button matches the rest of the app, and the Family Pack sheet has a close button and a clearer layout. - The selected sidebar row stands out better in Dark Mode.
